introHtml: Augusta Sportswear visors are built for active use, with moisture-wicking fabrics and structured brims that hold up to sun and sweat. Whether you're outfitting a softball team or a corporate golf outing, these visors offer a clean front panel for screen-printed or embroidered logos. Choose from classic navy, black, or white to match your uniforms or event colors.
